product: Blanco IKON 33 Silgranit Composite Apron Front (401734)

sources.snippet: IKON 33" apron-front single bowl. Silgranit composite material — patented formula with 80% natural granite. Heat resistant to 536°F (280°C). Scratch, stain, and impact resistant. Non-porous hygienic surface. Dimensions: 33" x 19" x 9-1/4" deep. cUPC certified. Limited lifetime warranty. Available in 9 colors. First composite apron-front sink on market.
sources.classification_reason: Manufacturer specs with patented material claims verified through independent testing references.

sources.snippet: Silgranit II: 35+ patents on material formula. 80% natural granite blended with proprietary acrylic resin. Tested to ANSI Z124 standards. UV-resistant (no color fading). Matte finish hides water spots and fingerprints. Metal transfer marks (from stainless steel pots rubbing against surface) are cosmetic and removable with mild abrasive cleaners like Bar Keepers Friend.
sources.classification_reason: Manufacturer technology documentation with patent and testing standard references.

sources.snippet: 5 years with Blanco Silgranit IKON. Zero scratches, zero stains, zero chips. The matte finish is genius — never shows water spots. Had metal transfer marks from cast iron pan — came off with Bar Keepers Friend in seconds. The composite material is genuinely tough. Only negative: can't find aftermarket accessories — need Blanco branded grids.
sources.classification_reason: Long-term consumer experience with specific durability data points.

sources.source_name: This Old House - Best Composite Sinks
sources.snippet: Blanco Silgranit consistently rated as the top composite sink material. The 80% granite content creates an extremely hard, dense surface that resists scratching better than stainless steel and staining better than fireclay. Heat resistance to 536°F is independently verified. The IKON was the first composite apron-front sink, and Blanco's material leadership in this space is well-established.
sources.classification_reason: Expert publication with comparative material analysis and independent verification.

sources.snippet: Composite sinks like Blanco Silgranit are a great middle ground — quieter than stainless, more impact-resistant than fireclay, lighter than cast iron. The IKON apron-front requires proper support but is lighter than comparable Kohler Whitehaven or Rohl Shaws. Expected lifespan 25-50 years with normal use. Composite body is inherently silent — no sound deadening needed.
sources.classification_reason: Professional plumber comparative analysis with lifespan estimate.

sources.snippet: BLANC & FISCHER Family Holding: private German family-owned company since 1925. Headquartered in Oberderdingen, Germany. Parent of Blanco, E.G.O., and ArcelikHitachi joint ventures. Revenue €2.3B group. Strong financial position. No going-concern risk.
sources.classification_reason: Corporate financial data — report finding, not scoring input.

bottom_line: Blanco IKON 33 is the composite farmhouse sink benchmark. Silgranit II formula (80% granite, 35+ patents) delivers exceptional scratch, stain, and heat resistance. Heat rated to 536°F independently verified. First composite apron-front on market — Blanco leads this space. Matte finish hides water spots and fingerprints — genuinely low maintenance. Metal transfer marks are cosmetic and easily removable. Composite body is inherently silent. Professional consensus rates Silgranit as the top composite material. Expected lifespan 25-50 years. German family-owned company since 1925. Trade-offs: brand-specific accessories ecosystem (limited aftermarket), slightly less heirloom character than fireclay or cast iron.
